top.line: The new data lake: append-only lanes, a curator agent, a semantic graph, and pictures drawn from it.
top.para: Data intelligence you can audit, as PrompTugal.news and Storm Charles ran it.

in-short.line: The swamp, lanes, the curator, the graph, the pictures, and the demo.

swamp.line: Buying data is expensive, and a lake without provenance becomes a swamp.
swamp.para: Nobody can say where a number came from.

lanes.line: Each source appends signed rows to its own lane and never edits the past.
lanes.para: A lane is a claim, not a fact, until something checks it.

curator.line: A curator agent turns rows into a graph whose every node points at its rows.

pictures.line: The graph draws the charts and infographics people read, at every release.
pictures.para: Storm Charles: 2,618 pages, each with its source.

insight.line: An insight is a claim with its evidence.
insight.para: Where the data lake meets the company brain.

demo.line: Four made-up lanes, a curator, a graph, a chart and insights.
demo.para: Click a lane to see its rows.

limits.line: Made-up demo data; signed rows prove who, not what.

sources.line: A conversation, the PrompTugal.news and Storm Charles repositories.
sources.para: With links to the companion articles.
